title: compute/v1 device enrolment (the client's side)
description: What the client (AgentDevice) sends and receives when a person installs it: POST /v1/devices. After enrolment the client joins its owner's NetBird network with the answer's `network` and reports facts with PUT /v1/computers/{id}/facts. README.md "Devices": contracts/compute/v1/README.md.

name.description: The device name the person chose in the client.

hostKey.description: The device's SSH host public key in OpenSSH authorized_keys format, generated by the client at its first start and kept. POST /v1/computers/{id}/access answers it as `hostKey`; enrolling again with another key replaces it.

user.description: The OS account the client runs as (on Windows without the computer prefix). Every SSH session runs as this account; /access answers it as `user`.

network.description: How the client's embedded NetBird (client/embed Options) joins the owner's network.

deviceName.description: The peer name to use (embed Options.DeviceName); the computer id, so peers and computers map one to one.

setupKey.description: A one-use NetBird setup key of the owner's account (embed Options.SetupKey). A secret: keep it in memory, never on a command line or in logs.

method.description: Log in with an identity/v1 token, aud netbird (embed Options.JWTToken); NetBird maps it to the owner's account (prototype P1).
